mobbin:908fac0b-b720-4eb8-b992-5ed2da827.summary: From empty forms home, author creates a Merch Pre-Order Form in a draft doc-style builder (scratch vs template, slash blocks, required fields, inline When/Then logic, matrix/rating/signature) ending still in Draft with Publish available—no share/QR screen in these steps.
steal: Draft badge + Preview + Publish in header until publish (steps 1–7) — clear unpublished state for scenario checklists.
Inline When/Then under a field (step 4) — hide/disable paths without a separate rules page.
Start-from-scratch vs Use a template on the blank canvas (steps 1–2).
Required asterisks on block titles (steps 4–7) — per-item required for rubric items.
avoid: Payment/wallet/Stripe blocks mid-checklist (steps 6–7) — noise for sim evaluation forms.
mobbin:908fac0b-b720-4eb8-b992-5ed2da827.fit: Extends Essentials checklist authoring beyond the cut-down Case Manager: one long doc page + draft/publish instead of only tabbed SCE fields; does not replace Equipment tabs.

mobbin:c7ec1d19-4938-4a20-87ea-dc9b92e82.summary: After account deletion, respondent fills a single open text reason with no login chrome, submits, then sees a thank-you confirmation from the makers.
steal: No account chrome on the form or thank-you (steps 0–2) — anonymous submit without login.
Thank you page with no further CTA (step 2) — clean end state after checklist submit.
avoid: Coupling feedback to account-deletion success (step 0) — wrong trigger for room/session feedback.
mobbin:c7ec1d19-4938-4a20-87ea-dc9b92e82.fit: Steals only anonymous no-login + thank-you for room-TV checklist-qr; does not show QR and is not a session evaluation flow.
